run_linear_training_benchmark: run a linear model training benchmark comparing PyTorch, NNC JIT, and TorchScript performance
create_functional_model: create a functional model from a PyTorch module using functorch make_functional for manual gradient updates
run_nnc_jit_compilation: run the nnc_jit compiler on a functional training step to optimize linear model training performance
